pages.title: Average Wattage of a Commercial Solar Panel (2026 Data)
pages.note: No agency publishes this number; the page computes it from CPUC DGStats (watts per module = DC size / module count, 2025 interconnections) and the CEC PV Module List full data (models listed 2025-09-21 to 2026-09-21), with the method printed on the page. pages.title: Solar Developers in California: Role, Pay and How to Vet
pages.note: Fold target for rows 19 (commercial solar PPA providers) and 22 (solar developers and EPCs). New section #ppa-providers: who offers commercial PPAs, 2025 CPUC DGStats counts (420 PPAs of 751 third-party-owned business systems, ~86% of TPO capacity; 116 of 124 at tax-exempt hosts), the 26 U.S.C. 7701(e)(3) service-contract rule, and a vetting checklist; FAQ 'Who are the commercial solar PPA providers in California?'. Names no provider. The developer/EPC distinction was already answered (role table + FAQ). Page not in any Tier 2 ownership list; edited because the lane instruction was to fold into the Tier 1 page that already answers the query.
